extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting out of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images for land use and land cover classification.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images of European cities distributed in over 34 countries were downloaded via Amazon S3. Images associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas with a low cloud level were selected to create a dataset of 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral image data provided by the Sentinel-2A satellite, downloaded via Amazon S3.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Bands with a lower spatial resolution have been upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times to correct the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice. The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, resulting in some images with a color cast, which were intentionally kept in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of 10 different land use and land cover classes. The residential class was created using the urban fabric classes described in the European Urban Atlas. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times and the ground truth was corrected by sorting out mislabeled images.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and resulting classification system can be used for Earth observation applications such as detecting land use and land cover changes (e.g., deforestation, which is a main contributor to climate change) and assisting in improving geographical maps, which is of interest in urban area development, nature protection, and sustainable development.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset distribution is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The proposed dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast. Additionally, a classification system trained with 64x64 image patches does not allow a finely graduated per-pixel segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for land use and land cover classification, land use and land cover change detection, and assistance in mapping.
